features.name: Faster gates and automatic run records: parallel tests, process adherence, feature summaries, review timeout
features.description: Cut the verify time, make every task leave its own telemetry without manual steps, and make outside-agent failures explain themselves.
acceptance_criteria: run-tests.sh runs files in parallel and prints the same lines, order, counts and exit code as the sequential run; a killed test is a failure; a signal stops the queue
every run record carries process_adherence (hook feedback, review attempts by family, subagents by type) with unmeasurable rules marked missing

session-clean attaches a summary to each completed feature, archives old features to keep the state layer under 6000 tokens without losing any, and keeps the last gate report for the window it falls in
outside-agent reviews default to 300 s and failed attempts log a bounded, scrubbed reason; return codes, order and classification are unchanged
all 11 harness gates pass
scripts/gate_experiment.py plants one defect per gate in a clone and reports which gates catch it; a gate is only called possibly redundant when another gate that stays covers every case it catches
features.evidence: Full gate time fell from about 220 s to 75-85 s (tests gate 70 s); 93 test files, identical ordered output at 1 and 4 jobs, 12 jobs x5 stress, SIGINT/SIGTERM leave no process. process_adherence measured on 76 real sessions with no change to existing fields. feature_run_record.py: 30 tests, 3,324 budget cases with no loss and none left over budget. outside_agent.py: 131 tests. Reviews by a fresh subagent, codex-kiro and agy found about 30 defects across the rounds (lost features without an id, archive overwrite and path escape, kill diagnostics interleaving, --jobs swallowing a flag, orphaned queue after SIGTERM, credential-shaped guard names, unscrubbed error text); each got a failing test first. Not done: the 5-runs-per-version benchmark comparison, SubagentStop double counting is unverified, claude-kiro is not an independent reviewer for a Claude caller by design. Gate-necessity experiment (scripts/gate_experiment.py, 12 planted-defect cases, 32 tests): baseline passes; types, clean state, runtime drift and secret scan are each the only catch for their defect; registry, skill paths, bash compat, cred backends, hook wiring and state layer overlap with the tests gate but together cost about 2 s, so nothing is recommended for removal. A fresh subagent found three cases that could not trigger their gate, a missing baseline, and a clone of HEAD instead of the working tree; all fixed with tests.

features.name: AGY statusline: one adaptive line with model, context, quota
features.description: AGY's custom statusline shows only user@host:cwd and [ctx]. With stack_with_default true it is one row inside a block AGY owns, so it shifts when the native part changes height. Render one line from the AGY payload (model, effort, context percent and tokens, lowest 5h quota, git branch), dropping fields by priority to fit terminal_width, and stop stacking with the native line.
acceptance_criteria: the script prints exactly one line (no newline) that fits terminal_width at 60, 80 and 160 columns, dropping fields in a fixed priority order
AGY payload fields render: model.display_name, context_window.used_percentage with used/total tokens, and the lowest remaining 5h quota
Claude Code payloads, which lack quota and model.effort, still render cwd and context as before
the script still returns without waiting for EOF when stdin stays open
install_statusline writes and refreshes stack_with_default false for gemini
all 11 harness gates pass
features.evidence: scripts/tests/test_statusline_command.sh: 28 passed (failed first: 17 of 24 before the rewrite, 4 of 28 after the review). One adaptive line from the AGY payload (model, bar, used/total, lowest 5h quota, git branch), dropping bar, branch, quota, model, cwd, token detail to fit terminal_width; install_statusline and setup-host.sh write stack_with_default false. Live agy in a detached tmux pane after install.sh: 160 cols shows all fields, 70 cols drops bar and branch. A fresh subagent found 3 defects (zero-token fresh session dropped context and quota, CJK width counted in characters, trailing-slash or root cwd showed no directory); each got a failing test first. Live long-response probe (agy in tmux, 30 rows): the row went to the bottom once the pane filled and stayed there with the new script, the old script with stacking off, and the old script with stacking on, so the movement was not reproduced; in one longer run the row ended one line above the bottom after the response finished, not compared against the old script. One full-gate run reported 94 passed, 1 failed in the tests gate; the failing test name was lost because the output was cut with tail; a rerun of harness-verify.sh and five consecutive run-tests.sh --fast runs all passed 95/95, so the failure is unreproduced and unattributed. Not done: current_usage is null before the first turn and filled after it (input_tokens, output_tokens), so an out figure is available but not shown; the one-line-above-bottom end state is unexplained.

features.name: AGY statusline follow-ups: end-of-response row position and output tokens
features.description: From feat-068. (b) After a long response the status row ended one line above the bottom in one live run; compare the old and new script with the same prompt to learn whether the script causes it. (a) Show output tokens from context_window.total_output_tokens, which is present before and after the first turn.
acceptance_criteria: the same long prompt is run live against the old script, the new script and the old script with stacking on, and the end-of-response row of each is recorded
if the new script causes the shift it is fixed with a failing test first; if AGY's own layout causes it, that is recorded and no script change is made
the status line shows output tokens when total_output_tokens is above 0, and drops them before the token detail when the width is short
Claude Code payloads and the stdin-held-open case still pass
all 11 harness gates pass, with gate output saved to a file
features.evidence: Row position: the same long prompt (numbers 1-80 plus a 25-line poem) in live agy under tmux, 30 rows, two rounds each: the new script, the old script with stacking off, and the old script with stacking on all ended with the status row on the bottom line (row 30); intermediate rows 14-19 appear in all three, so they come from the pane filling. The one-line-above-bottom end state seen once earlier did not reproduce in six runs, so no script change was made for it and its cause is unknown. Output tokens: scripts/tests/test_statusline_command.sh 32 passed (failed first: 1 of 31, then 1 of 32). The line shows 'out N' from context_window.total_output_tokens only above 0 and drops it with the branch, before quota, model, cwd and token detail; a fresh subagent found a count of 999500 rendering as 1000k, fixed with a failing test first. harness-verify.sh passed all 11 gates with its output saved to a file. Not done: a non-integer total_output_tokens is not shown (AGY sends integers); the shift seen once is unexplained; saving gate output to a file is done by hand, harness-verify.sh does not do it.

features.name: Run records that attach to the right feature and show gate runs
features.description: feat-068 and feat-069 got a wrong or missing run summary because session-clean ran before the completion commit existed: the feature step said 'not completed' and the run step still wrote a record nobody claimed. Report that case under its own status, do not write the stray record, record how many gate runs fell in a window, correct the two summaries from their real records, and put the order in AGENTS.md.
acceptance_criteria: a completed feature whose completion is not committed reports 'completion not committed', not 'not completed', and a feature that is not completed still reports 'not completed'
session-clean.sh prints a loud warning for uncommitted completions and writes no run-telemetry record in that case
each run record carries gate_runs (count, passed, failed, failed gate names) from a log that harness-verify.sh appends to, measured when the log exists and missing otherwise
the feat-068 and feat-069 summaries are rebuilt from their real records with summary_from_record, no numbers typed by hand
AGENTS.md End of Session gives the order: commit the completion, run session-clean.sh, commit the telemetry files
an outside-agent review of the install-script changes from feat-068 is run, or its absence is stated in the evidence
all 11 harness gates pass, with gate output saved to a file
features.verification: python3 -m pytest tests/test_feature_run_record.py tests/test_run_telemetry.py -q && bash scripts/harness-verify.sh
features.evidence: Failing tests first, then code: tests/test_feature_run_record.py (2 new), tests/test_run_telemetry.py (3 new, gate_runs), scripts/tests/test_session_clean.sh (2 new), scripts/tests/test_harness_verify.sh (2 new); 180 pytest and all shell tests pass, mypy clean, harness-verify.sh passed all 11 gates with output saved to a file. A completion not yet committed now reports 'completion not committed' and session-clean.sh warns and writes no run record; harness-verify.sh appends one line per run to ~/.agent-skills-setup/state/harness-verify-runs.jsonl and each run record carries gate_runs (count, passed, failed, failed gate names). feat-068 and feat-069 summaries were rebuilt from their real records with summary_from_record (feat-068: 5097 output tokens, 15.3e6 ms wall; feat-069: 1669, 1.99e6 ms); the stray records 57f13686b4, f9dc9c7a13 and cb5536ef29 stay in docs/telemetry/runs as unclaimed. AGENTS.md End of Session now gives the order. A new test found that harness/guards/tests/test_stop_verify.sh ran the real harness-verify.sh against the caller's HOME and wrote 4 fake gate runs per run-tests.sh call; it now uses a temp report path. Outside review of feat-068 (codex-kiro) gave 3 findings, none introduced by it: setup-host.sh overwrites a foreign AGY statusLine and install_statusline leaves stack_with_default alone when the statusLine is foreign (both as before feat-068), and the refresh path has no Python fallback without jq (also as before; the statusline script itself needs jq and renders nothing without it). Not fixed, queued. Review by a fresh-context subagent (no outside model; the change is telemetry and test plumbing, not hooks or permissions) found 5 points; 4 reproduced and fixed with a failing test first (a1683a1): (1) an unwritable state dir printed a redirect error from the new log append, so console output changed; (2) feature_run_record.py ignored HARNESS_VERIFY_LAST_REPORT while harness-verify.sh and session-clean.sh honored it; (3) an empty HARNESS_VERIFY_LAST_REPORT meant 'keep nothing' in harness-verify.sh but fell back to the real log in session-clean.sh; (4) session-clean.sh matched the phrase 'completion not committed' anywhere in the output, now only a status line ending in it. Also found by running the close in the new order: the feature record built its own run record without the gate runs log, so gate_runs was missing from feat-070's record; fixed with a failing test first (ea4bb74). Not fixed: a completed feature in a repo where git fails or feature_list.json is untracked reports 'completion not committed' (true in the sense that no commit shows it, but the cause is not named); harness-verify-runs.jsonl is never rotated and is read whole for each record (about 1 line per gate run); every session-clean.sh run writes one small tail record that no feature claims; the order (commit, then session-clean) is a warning and a rule in AGENTS.md, not a block.
